title: Module Review Quiz: Arrays & Strings (CPP_144 to CPP_151)

slides.title: Arrays & Strings Overview
slides.prompt: This Module Quiz covers single and multi-dimensional arrays, C-style strings, C++ std::string methods, array traversal, and bounds checking (CPP_144 to CPP_151).

slides.title: Array Declaration (CPP_144)
slides.prompt: Fill in the correct index value to access the first element of an array.

slides.title: Array Indexing (CPP_144)
slides.prompt: In an array declared as 'int arr[10];', what is the index of the last element?

slides.title: Array Size Initialization (CPP_145)
slides.prompt: Fill in the missing array size in brackets for declaring 3 integer elements.

slides.title: 2D Array Concept (CPP_146)
slides.prompt: How is a 2D array typically visualized in C++?
options: A table with rows and columns
slides.correctAnswer: A table with rows and columns

slides.title: 2D Array Access (CPP_146)
slides.prompt: Fill in the brackets to access row 0, column 1 of a 2D matrix.

slides.title: C-Style String Terminator (CPP_147)
slides.prompt: Which character automatically marks the end of a C-style character string (char array)?

slides.title: String Length (CPP_148)
slides.prompt: Fill in the method name used to retrieve the number of characters in a std::string.

slides.title: String Concatenation (CPP_148)
slides.prompt: Which operator is used to concatenate two std::string objects together in C++?

slides.title: String Append Method (CPP_149)
slides.prompt: Fill in the method used to attach text to the end of an existing std::string variable.

slides.title: Array Bounds Checking (CPP_150)
slides.prompt: What happens if you try to access an index outside the declared size of a standard C++ array?
options: Undefined behavior (may crash or read garbage memory)
A clear compile error is always generated
slides.correctAnswer: Undefined behavior (may crash or read garbage memory)

slides.title: Reading Strings with Spaces (CPP_151)
slides.prompt: Fill in the function used to read an entire line of text including spaces from cin.

slides.title: Array Size Calculation (CPP_145)
slides.prompt: Which formula correctly computes the number of elements in an array 'arr'?

slides.title: Character Access in String (CPP_148)
slides.prompt: Fill in the bracket syntax to get the first character of string 'str'.

slides.title: String Substring Method (CPP_149)
slides.prompt: Which method is used to extract a portion of a string in C++?
